summary: Denver rallied from 15 down to beat Chicago 133-128, with Nikola Jokić posting a triple-double in 26 minutes. Cleveland beat Orlando 119-105 behind 24 points from James Harden, and Charlotte led Milwaukee by as many as 24 in a 105-90 win. In Macao, Dallas beat Houston 132-115 to split the two China Games, with Kyrie Irving scoring 17 points in his return.

games.headline: Mavericks beat Rockets 132-115 to split China Games
games.story: Dallas led 58-51 at halftime and was tied with Houston at 77-77 midway through the third quarter, the last time the Rockets were level. The Mavericks outscored Houston 37-30 in the fourth and led by as many as 19 points. Kyrie Irving scored 17 points on 6-of-13 shooting in under 22 minutes, and Cooper Flagg had 14 points and 7 assists. Marcus Smart led all scorers with 20 for Houston, which got 14 each from Amen Thompson and Jabari Smith Jr.

games.headline: Hornets pull away from Bucks, 105-90
games.story: Charlotte trailed 31-29 early in the second quarter, then led the rest of the way and was up 60-45 at halftime. The lead peaked at 24 points, and Milwaukee never led by more than 9. Brandon Miller scored 18 points on 6-of-15 shooting with 4 assists, and Moussa Diabaté had 11 rebounds. Tyler Herro matched Miller with 18 points and added 7 rebounds for the Bucks, and Naz Reid scored 16 in 20 minutes.

games.headline: Cavaliers beat Magic 119-105 behind Harden's 24
games.story: Cleveland led 61-50 at halftime and went ahead for good after a 66-66 tie with 5:51 left in the third quarter. The lead grew to 18 points, and Orlando's largest lead was 1. James Harden scored 24 points on 7-of-10 shooting, 20 of them before halftime. Evan Mobley had 14 points and 7 rebounds, and Tristan da Silva led the Magic with 17 points.

games.headline: Nuggets rally past Bulls 133-128, Jokić triple-double
games.story: Chicago led 68-59 at halftime and by as many as 15 points before Denver outscored the Bulls 40-26 in the third quarter. The game was tied 91-91 with 1:13 left in the third, and Denver led from there. Nikola Jokić had 22 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists in 26 minutes, and Aaron Gordon scored 25 on 9-of-12 shooting. Leonard Miller led all scorers with 26 points for Chicago, and Caleb Wilson added 17.
